description: This Java source file defines the AnnotationSourcer class, which extends org.objectweb.asm.AnnotationVisitor to generate Java source code for annotations during bytecode manipulation.

classes.name: AnnotationSourcer
classes.description: A class that generates Java source code representations of annotations using ASM bytecode library.

methods.name: AnnotationSourcer(Output output)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AnnotationSourcer with an output writer, assumes not an array.

methods.name: AnnotationSourcer(Output output, boolean isArray)
methods.description: Constructor that sets up AnnotationSourcer with output and array status.

methods.name: visit(String name, Object value)
methods.description: Handles visiting a name-value pair in an annotation and writes it to output.

methods.name: visitEnd()
methods.description: Handles completion of annotation visiting and writes closing characters.

methods.name: visitArray(String name)
methods.description: Handles visiting an array annotation element, returning a new AnnotationSourcer for nested array.

methods.name: visitEnum(String name, String desc, String value)
methods.description: Handles visiting an enum annotation value, here it simply logs a message indicating unsupported feature.
